svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hood: fold 1 mm aluminium into a box 120 deep, 150 wide and 100 tall with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one 150 x 100 face open (toward the funnel), seams pop riveted.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 100 mm hole in the top for the duct stub; rivet on a 100 mm round

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: stub (a square stub is drawn) for the flexible duct.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm: 30 x 5 mm flat bar, 200 mm long; bend 90 degrees 45 mm from one

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end, flat way. Long leg: two 5.5 mm holes 20 and 70 mm from its free

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end. Short leg: two 6.5 mm holes 10 and 35 mm from the bend's outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the short leg bolts to the column's left face with two M6 screws

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into rivnuts; the long leg lies on the hood's back face, two M5

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws and nuts. The hood's open face is 100 mm from the funnel axis,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its centre level with the flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the hood stays put when pushed by hand.
